_readme.purpose: Hand-assembled indicator histories for the backtest (scripts/backtest.py) that are NOT already in data/fred-series.json: Manheim wholesale index, Cox retail listing prices, Ford truck deliveries. Extracted from the Cox monthly MUVVI / used-vehicle-inventory pages and Ford quarterly sales PDFs; extraction code is a one-off (regex over page text) and every derived value carries a `basis` note.
known_gaps: Wholesale days' supply history before 2026 could not be parsed reliably (pages mix retail and wholesale figures) and is excluded from correlations.
Retail days' supply history before 2026 likewise excluded.
GM deliveries history unavailable: GM's official tables block automated access (see Section 4 of the tracker).
Ford history covers 2024Q4 onward only: older Ford release URLs didn't follow the pattern used for newer releases.
ATP (KBB full-size pickup) history exists only from 2025-12; too short to correlate.
